name: pay-button
title: Pay button
description: The checkout button with its whole life: the amount on it, locked until the form is valid, processing, the bank step, paid, and failed with a safe retry.
docs: Send every press's attempt id to your server as the idempotency key. Pass disabledReason while the form is invalid, status from your payment provider (or let the promise from onPay drive it), and call step.authenticating() when the bank asks for a confirmation. Inside a checkout form use type="submit".
